items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: ask Sugar Lou and Eddie... Yes. Sugar Lou and Eddie. Both of them sang and they had a five or six piece band

ctx.x: So we went out and there wasn't anything to do, Pete didn't want to go around there anyway and what made it so bad, he went in as a favor for me, his dad ran a pool hall in Tulsa and they had--whatever year that was-- twenty seven or twenty eight--- had a brand new Studebaker and they let Pete have it. His dad had told him, his old man talked kind of slow--I don't know about that car down there, something might even happen.
